english.meaning: sharp; impressive, as in 犀利
english.note: 犀唔犀利 means isn't that impressive. This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.traditional: 係囖。即係有八千六百五啊。犀唔犀利啊？
